description: This file defines a custom attribute class 'PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute' used in Orleans for specifying placement filtering based on silo metadata matching. It includes metadata about the preferred matching strategy for silos in a distributed system.

classes.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
classes.description: A custom attribute class used to specify preferred silo placement filtering based on metadata matching, with configurable keys and candidate count.

methods.name: PreferredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterAttribute
methods.description: Constructor for the attribute, initializing it with ordered metadata keys, minimum candidates, and order.
